info.name: WorkBoard External Public Activity (Action Items) Activity (Action Items) User API
Get an individual user, or all users with a Data-Admin token.

params.name: user_id
params.description: **Data-Admin:** Pass the user_id OR email address for the user.

params.name: custom_attributes
params.description: Return the custom attributes for a specific user. Use `custom_attributes=1` to return the values.

params.name: opt_filters
params.description: If you have provisioned your users with a unique identifier generated by your system, then you can query them with this attribute. opt_filters can be set to a JSON with the following format: opt_filters={"external_id": ["externalids"]} — where "externalids" is an array of the external ids. Example: opt_filters={"external_id": ["a123bc", "ax123b"]}

params.name: include
params.description:
• Data-Admin: Add include=org_members to return an array of all users of the organization. See `limit` and `offset` for pagination.
  • Add include=team_members to return an array of members from teams to which the current user has access.
  • Add include=org_reports to return an array of reports for the given `user_id`.

params.name: limit
params.description: • Data-Admin: Use in combination with `include=org_members` and `offset` to return a paginated list of users of the organization. `limit` is the number of results to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: • Data-Admin: Use in combination with `include=org_members` and `limit` to return a paginated list of users of the organization. `offset` is the number of results to skip before returning a result.

items.docs: **Without any parameters, this will return the user profile associated with the token. If the token is a 'Data-Admin' token, some parameters will return a different result.**
